lines.t: Praise the Lord YAHUWAH in His sanctuary; Praise Him in His mighty firmament!
Praise Him for His mighty acts;
Praise Him according to His greatness!
Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet and harp.
Flutes and stringed instruments and clashing cymbals. Shout HALLELU'YAH
(Chorus)
For HE is good.
HE is Holy.
HE is a Holy, Holy LORD
The Lord takes pleasure in His people;
He will beautify the humble with salvation. Let the saints be joyful in glory;
Sing and praise!
(Chorus)
For HE is good.
HE is Holy.
HE is a Holy, Holy LORD
Give HIM all your praise!
Dance and give HIM praise!
Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Praise the Lord!
For HE is Holy, Holy Holy
